text: The default maximum hand size is 8.
The default starting life total is 50.
Each player begins the game with a Treasure token in play under their control.
Players reveal all cards they find while searching libraries, regardless if the effect says so or not.
At the beginning of the first upkeep, each player scries X, where X is their position in turn order minus 1.
The default starting life total is 30.
The first spell each player casts each turn costs 1 generic mana less to cast.
Each player may have the first land they play during each of their turns enter untapped.
Commander spells cost 1 generic mana less to cast.
The default starting life total is 60.
Players have no default maximum hand size.
The default maximum hand size is 6.
Commander spells cost 2 generic mana more to cast.
Spells costs 1 generic mana more to cast.
Before starting hands are drawn, each player searches the library of the player to their left for up to four cards and exiles them, then shuffles.
The default maximum hand size is 4.
Players play with their hands revealed.
Players don't lose mana as steps and phases end.
Damage isn't removed from permanents during the cleanup step.
Whenever a player loses life, that player exiles that many cards off the top of their library.
All spells have flash.
